name: apple-health-mcp
description: Query your Apple Health export — records, workouts, GPS routes and ECGs — from a local DuckDB database.
long_description:
Imports an Apple Health export into DuckDB and exposes it over MCP. Every tool is read-only and runs entirely on your machine: nothing is uploaded, and the bundled server only ever opens the database file you point it at.

Before installing, run `apple-health-mcp import --export-dir /path/to/apple_health_export` once to build the database. It lands in ~/.config/apple-health-mcp/health.duckdb, which is prefilled below.

You can re-import later while Claude still has this extension loaded — the server holds the database open only for the length of each query.

database_path.title: Health database
database_path.description: The health.duckdb file produced by `apple-health-mcp import` (the default import location is prefilled below)

tools.name: list_record_types
tools.description: List all health record types with counts and date ranges

tools.name: query_records
tools.description: Query records by type, date range, and source

tools.name: get_record_statistics
tools.description: Aggregated stats (avg/min/max/sum) by day, week, month, or year

tools.name: get_workout_details
tools.description: Full workout details including events, statistics, and route availability

tools.name: get_workout_route
